page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-lc1m1.small is an entry-level virtual server configured on the KVM hypervisor within the shared-instance family. It provides 1 burstable vCPU backed by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware features include AVX, AVX-512 (F and VNNI variants), and AES acceleration. The system is provisioned with 1.0 GB of memory and does not include dedicated local storage, GPUs, or bundled public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark outcomes reflect its minimal resource profile and burstable allocation model. In compute evaluations, stress-ng yields 1064.79 points across single-core and multi-core executions, ranking in the bottom percentiles. PassMark CPU testing measures an overall score of 1212.67, with extended instructions scoring 1103.01, encryption at 377.59, and physics operations at 148.53. Memory throughput ranges from 76.47 GB/sec for small cached blocks down to 8.43 GB/sec read and 6.75 GB/sec write for large 256 MB blocks.

Application-level measurements indicate 1.34 million operations per second for Redis SET commands and 1.28 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Because baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps and system memory is limited to 1.0 GB, throughput degrades under concurrent or memory-dense operations.

This server type is engineered for low-overhead administrative tasks, lightweight staging environments, periodic cron jobs, and basic test workloads with intermittent compute demands. Sustained heavy processing, database hosting, and memory-intensive production workloads require higher-tier instance profiles.
